description: NSW Road Network Categorisation is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Transport for NSW. This dataset provides spatial data of NSW roads categorised as either State or Regional Roads. Road Categories State Roads – the responsibility of Transport, funded by the NSW Government Regional Roads – the responsibility of local government, partly funded by the NSW Government Available Data Formats The dataset is available in a variety of geospatial ... It offers 7 resource(s) in CSV, GEOJSON, JSON, KML, MAP. The portal shows 2026-03-01 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
